responsibility: Implements forward propagation of single-use expressions and address computations in GIMPLE SSA. The pass pushes simple RHS expressions, casts, boolean tests, address expressions, bitfield/vector/permutation idioms, and selected builtin simplifications into their uses—especially conditions, switches, and memory-address expressions—to expose folding, branch threading, and later CFG cleanup opportunities while maintaining a lightweight const/copy lattice for local propagation.
